bcbs_2011.claim: During the financial crisis, roughly two-thirds of losses attributed to counterparty credit risk were due to CVA losses and only about one-third were due to actual defaults.
bcbs_2011.source: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, press release, 1 June 2011

model_note: Illustrative model: receive-fixed 5y swap at par, value = -N x (T - t) x (rate move); rate moves are Brownian with 1% a year normal vol; flat hazard from the credit triangle; flat 3% discounting; no netting, collateral or wrong-way risk. 10,000 paths, seed 7, monthly grid.
